Claude Platform on AWS bills through AWS Marketplace using Claude Consumption Units (CCUs). Anthropic rates your token usage in USD at standard per-model, per-feature rates, applies any negotiated discount, converts the result to CCUs at $0.01 per CCU, and reports the CCU quantity to AWS Marketplace hourly. Your AWS bill shows a single CCU line item.

results.summary:
The page outlines Anthropic’s pricing for Claude models and platform features, all in USD. Key sections:

- Model pricing: detailed per-model costs for input tokens, cache writes (5-minute and 1-hour) and hits/refreshes, and output tokens. Examples include Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.x, Claude Sonnet 5/4.x, and Claude Haiku 4.5/3.5 (pricing varies by model). Introductory pricing of $2 per million input/output tokens through Aug 31, 2026; standard pricing after that is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
- Cache pricing: explains the additional costs for prompt caching (5m cache writes, 1h cache writes, cache hits & refreshes).
- Cloud platforms pricing: pricing for Claude on partner-operated clouds (AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Foundry), including how Claude Consumption Units (CCUs) are calculated and billed through the respective marketplaces.
- Platform-specific notes: Claude is available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud; mentions data residency pricing and a 10% premium for regional/multi-region endpoints.
- Feature-specific pricing: covers pricing related to specific features (e.g., prompt caching).

Overall, the page provides comprehensive, model-by-model token-based pricing, cache-related costs, and marketplace/cloud integration pricing for Claude.
